buildCmd: bun run build:lib && bunx @tailwindcss/cli@4 -i src/index.css -o .design-sync/arc-ds.tw.css --minify && cat .design-sync/arc-ds.head.css .design-sync/arc-ds.tw.css src/landing.css > .design-sync/arc-ds.css

dtsPropsFor.LandingPage: /** The standalone Arc marketing homepage. Renders the full page — hero, install, architecture, docs — with no required props. */
dtsPropsFor.DiagramStudio: /** The standalone Arc studio — the full diagram editor (top bar, canvas, floating toolbar, properties panel) loaded with a sample diagram. No required props. */
dtsPropsFor.ArcDiagramEngineering: /** Arc architecture diagram in the Engineering theme — systematic blue on structured gray. No required props. */
dtsPropsFor.ArcDiagramWorkbench: /** Arc architecture diagram in the Workbench theme — dark slate with intent colors. No required props. */
dtsPropsFor.ArcDiagramTactical: /** Arc architecture diagram in the Tactical theme — tactical black with signature amber. No required props. */
